changelog:
✨ New Features
• Show at most one Morphe snackbar message each second
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide GIF button" and "Hide GIFs and images" comment settings
• Restore old video action bar: Add the "Classic Two-Rows" layout to "Video action bar layout", and remove "Enable tablet layout in player"
• Feed video actions: Watch later button shows a check mark if the video is saved, and removes the video when tapped
• Restore old video action bar: Replace the setting with "Video action bar layout", with the Default, Classic and Minimal layouts
• Captions: Add bilingual captions with synchronized blocks
• Add Translate live chat patch
• GmsCore support: Support video/audio casting to other devices (Requires latest MicroG-RE)
• Minimal miniplayer: Add "Docked miniplayer" and "Expand with swipe up" settings
• Add Change PiP actions patch
• Downloads: Export in-app videos to device storage
• Theme: Add setting to configure 'Glow' splash screen duration, and allow tapping to skip animation

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio and thumbnail downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Change start page: Top bar and navigation bar show the default buttons for 20 seconds without a cached guide
• Feed view count: Badge of a vertical thumbnail is in the middle of the thumbnail until the title row is drawn
• Feed view count: Loading spinner is shown on cards whose title row is not drawn yet, such as long thumbnails
• Feed view count: View count of the previous video is shown for a moment when a list reuses a card, such as in the notifications
• Downloads: Use default export folder if the picked folder is missing
• Consolidate "Hide cast button" into a single setting
• Crash on Android 12 when closing a settings screen with a new setting
• Search comments: Improved the check of the comments panels
